name: comp-136
blurb: Checkbox that strikes through its label when checked.
description: Pre-checked todo-style checkbox where the label gets a line-through decoration based on the checkbox's checked state using peer-data selectors.
use_when: Building todo lists or task completion interfaces.
avoid_when: Read-only interfaces—the strikethrough should indicate completion.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated. Strikethrough is visual only; semantic state conveyed by checked attribute.
